 Summary
 Use the 'watch & listen' tab for BBC Radio 5 Live commentary or to watch Champions League Final Score
 Bayern 2-1 Arsenal - Eze replaces injured Saka and puts Gunners ahead; Davies responds and Kane nets from spot
 Villa 3-0 Viking - Barkley with opener, Buendia doubles lead from spot before Heggheim own goal
 FT: Como 4-1 Man Utd - Paz curls superb opener for hosts after two minutes, Douvikas doubles lead after break before Paz grabs his second and Jacobo Ramon makes it four. Zirkzee with last response
 Read about Italian club's rise here 
 Here's Viking's special story 
 Real Madrid & Inter in action - follow all scores here

 Bayern showing why they are one of the big sides. No shame in being second best. Arsenal had a favourable run last year and have looked more vulnerable at the back this season. 
Kane is still in the top 3 strikers. World class!

 'Bayern Munich's tails are up' published at 21:27 BST 21:27 BST 
 Bayern Munich 2-1 Arsenal 
 Matt Upson 
Former Arsenal defender on BBC Radio 5 Live 
 This is a massive test for Arsenal now. Not only to think about how do they get back into this game by scoring a goal, but also to stay firm for the next 10 minutes or so. They're in a really vulnerable point here. Bayern Munich's tails are up.
